_doc: Model capabilities per model id prefix (D33, CONTRACTS section 3). Owner: A1. The region prefix of an inference profile id (global., us., eu., apac., jp., au., us-gov.) is removed before the match; the longest matching prefix wins. json_mode: tool = Converse toolConfig with a forced tool; native = Converse outputConfig.textFormat json_schema; prompt = JSON instruction + parse + one retry. cache = Converse cachePoint support; min_cache_tokens = minimum cached prefix. allows_temperature false = never send temperature/topP. extra_fields = additionalModelRequestFields for every call; role_extra_fields = extra fields per LLM role. Prices: USD per M tokens; null = unknown (role goes to CostSummary.price_unknown). Cache read/write tokens are priced at price_in_per_m times cache_read_mult / cache_write_mult. Verified with real Converse calls in us-east-1 on 2026-10-30: global.anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5, global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5 (native JSON, cachePoint, no temperature, forced tool_choice rejected on Sonnet 5.5) and us.amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0 (forced tool ok, no outputConfig, cachePoint ok).
